description: Search the Google Maps business categories MapsData can scrape. CALL THIS FIRST, before mapsdata_start_scrape: a scrape's query must be one of these exact categories, and a free-text guess like 'plumbing companies' is rejected.

country.description: Optional: the country you will scrape. Categories Google rarely uses there are flagged, with local alternatives (e.g. 'General contractor' in au).

name: mapsdata_search_categories
title: Search Google Maps categories
